topic.title: Updating XML Documents using XQuery Update 1.0

body.p: Using the bundled Saxon EE XQuery processor offers support for XQuery Update 1.0. The XQuery Update Facility provides expressions that can be used to make persistent changes to instances of the XQuery 1.0 and XPath 2.0 Data Model. Thus, besides querying XML documents, you can modify them using the various insert/delete/modify/create methods available in the XQuery Update 1.0 standard.

Choose Saxon EE as a transformer in the scenario associated with the XQuery files that contain update statements and will notify you if the update was successful.You also need to make sure the Enable XQuery update option is selected in the Saxon processor advanced options.

b.u: Example: Using XQuery Update to modify a tag name in an XML file
